assertions.assertion: Metadata is stored in AuthenticationProperties.Items and passed to HttpContext.SignInAsync(user, properties)
assertions.rationale: properties.Items["device_name"]/["region"] are set and passed to HttpContext.SignInAsync(user, properties).

assertions.assertion: The ASP.NET Identity path passes properties to SignInManager.SignInWithClaimsAsync (and notes overriding it in a custom SignInManager when PasswordSignInAsync is used)
assertions.rationale: It passes properties to SignInWithClaimsAsync but never mentions overriding it in a custom SignInManager for the PasswordSignInAsync flow, so the compound assertion is not fully satisfied.

assertions.assertion: Response states the metadata is NOT issued as claims
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states the metadata is part of the ticket and is not issued as claims.

assertions.assertion: Response notes custom metadata is not indexed and cannot be filtered via SessionQuery — query by subject/session/display name first, then inspect tickets
assertions.rationale: The response does not mention that the custom metadata is unindexed or that it cannot be filtered via SessionQuery.
